A slip: a printed strip showing the card type line and its corrected game text, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 January 2013 (the PDF was made on 16 April 2013).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-D-thecircleisnowcomplete-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[The Circle Is Now Complete]]: The game text is reworded: “If Vader and Obi-Wan are present at same site, use 1 Force to initiate a duel between them. Compare their power, and add 2 if that character is armed with a lightsaber. Loser (lowest total) of duel is placed out of play.” These are the same words as [[The Circle Is Now Complete (Decipher Errata 2002)|Decipher's errata]]. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with a title and a white italic “E”.

The same area of the printed card (scaled to the slip's width) and the 2013 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
